scope: Unpublished 2D composition authoring workflow separation across six independent existing editors; pure candidate verifier and injected workflow, browser adapter and parent/source host ports. No new editor layout, scene format, Rust rule, backend, version, installation or device delivery.

compositionAndNewFocused.coverageOverlap: These focused tests are included in fullApplication; counts are not summed.

prepared.scope: Standard VM context exposes WebAssembly and text codecs only, without Node/DOM/fetch/process globals. Harness ports supply JSON DTOs and deterministic SHA; this proves copied module portability, not a hostile-code sandbox or device acceptance.

preservation.oldAtlasPrefixes: preserved; new independent workflow coordinates appended

initialEvidence.case: The new projection-inheritance fixture assumed a wrong default size; test fixture corrected, product unaffected.

The old test required shared callback reference identity. Changed only that architectural constraint to independent workflows while validating both full POST/DELETE source receipts. Review: old-test-contract-review.json.
Readonly review found inherited prototype-name configuration kinds; new own-key guard and malformed-kind tests added before product freeze. Boundary-review report records resolution.

cleanup.ownership: Only baseline-absent directories generated by this slice.

boundaries: UI approval, input signatures and local undo remain with each independent controller.
Source ports must perform exact source preparation and last live owner checks; ordinary Save remains the host authority.
The pure workflow validates owner and proposal contracts but is not a malicious injected-port security sandbox.
Unused fragments still validate authored declarations/registered dependencies without effective-instance rendering.
Standard VM portability and prepared copies do not establish installed Tauri or Android device acceptance.
Ordinary scene transactions, execution lifecycle, cross-view history, new ergonomic interactions and multi-file edits remain separate future scopes.
